title: What Makes Code Hard To Read: Visual Patterns of Complexity
summary: Distills Halstead Complexity Metrics and Cognitive Complexity into 8 observable visual patterns that make code hard to read.
when-to-read: Read when reviewing code for readability, explaining why a piece of code feels hard to follow, or setting readability standards for a team. Do not read for architectural or design-pattern concerns — this is about line-level visual/structural readability, not system structure.
